description: Plan 2 — Estimator & Artifacts. Turns the GENERATE state from wired-but-inert into the step that produces a project brief, an indicative quote, and an email.

complexity.reasoning: 9 functional requirements x2, 3 integration points x3 (DeepSeek, Resend, D1), 1 database change x2, 2 external APIs x3 => 35/5 = 7

baseline.note: Plan 1 merged at ff1ae4d. Suite must never regress below this and must stay warning-free.

userStories.title: Contract additions
userStories.description: As the UI and the Worker, we need shared wire types for the estimator, quote, and generate response so they cannot drift.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/ba-bot-contract exports CategoryNameSchema, ConfidenceSchema, EstimateCategorySchema, SubsystemSchema, EstimateShapeSchema, QuoteSchema, GenerateResponseSchema and their inferred types
EstimateShapeSchema is a discriminatedUnion on mode with single and program variants
Contract package typecheck clean; Worker typecheck clean
No Cloudflare imports in the contract package
userStories.notes: StateIdSchema already existed in the file; appended new section directly after ErrorCodeSchema. All new types are plain interfaces/schemas with no I/O — safe for Task 2 (pricing) and Task 3 (estimator) to import directly.

userStories.title: Category-weighted banded pricing
userStories.description: As the business, I want task counts converted to a defensible price band so the quote reflects real complexity variance.
acceptanceCriteria: CATEGORY_WEIGHTS covers all 7 categories; Integrations weighted above UI/UX
weightedTasks sums across categories and across subsystems in program mode
Bands are +/-25/35/50 percent for high/medium/low confidence
belowFloor is true when the midpoint is under MINIMUM_ENGAGEMENT_AUD
weeks rounds up and is never zero
Module is pure: no I/O, no LLM
userStories.notes: CATEGORY_WEIGHTS is a pure data module; priceQuote applies confidence-dependent band widths (±25/35/50%) and enforces belowFloor flag for engagement floor. Both modules are pure and import only from @unodigit/ba-bot-contract.

userStories.title: Shape estimator, single mode
userStories.description: As the quoting system, I want the model to return the SHAPE of a claw-forge decomposition rather than 100-300 bullets, cutting output tokens ~45x.
acceptanceCriteria: runEstimate returns a Zod-validated EstimateShape
ESTIMATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT is byte-frozen and sent as the first message
Exactly one repair retry on malformed JSON; empty and truncated short-circuit without retrying
A shape whose category counts contradict total_tasks is rejected as unparseable
PII grep over src/llm, src/graph/prompts.ts and src/estimator returns only the do-not-ask prompt line
userStories.notes: 88/10 pass, zero warnings; typecheck clean; PII grep clean (extra src/estimator hits are the schema field name "name" and calibration prose "email", not lead data).

userStories.title: Estimator program mode
userStories.description: As a large project, I want to be split into subsystems, because claw-forge targets 100-300 bullets per spec and a phased first-subsystem price converts better than one large total.
acceptanceCriteria: A first pass over PROGRAM_MODE_THRESHOLD triggers a second program-mode pass
Under the threshold makes exactly one call
A failed program pass falls back to the valid oversized single estimate rather than erroring
Token usage is summed across both passes
The frozen prompt is the first system message in both passes so the cached prefix is shared
userStories.notes: 92/11 zero warnings, typecheck clean. Fixed plan's bigSingle fixture (540) to 350: it violated the Task-1 schema's own max(400) on bullets/total_tasks, making tests 3-4 structurally unsatisfiable regardless of implementation; corrected to stay schema-valid and still over programThreshold.

userStories.title: Oversized first pass reaches program mode
userStories.description: As a large project, I want an over-400-task first pass to route to program mode instead of failing schema validation, because the spec sets no upper bound on the program-mode trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: A first pass over 400 tasks reaches program mode instead of returning reason:'parse'
The ceiling is raised (2000), not removed: an absurd 5000-task pass is still rejected
SubsystemSchema.total_tasks stays at max(400) — the per-subsystem bound is intentional
totalsAgree requires each subsystem to agree with its own total, not just the umbrella
Frozen ESTIMATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT, PROGRAM_MODE_ADDENDUM and CALIBRATION are byte-unchanged
userStories.notes: Controller ruling, not a plan task — spec beats plan. RED confirmed for both fixes by reverting source and re-running, not by assertion. Deferred: askOnce maxTokens 1600 may truncate a 6-subsystem program shape; degrades gracefully to the single estimate.

userStories.title: Brief and quote markdown renderers
userStories.description: As the dashboard and the email, we need markdown as the single canonical artifact form.
acceptanceCriteria: buildBriefSections degrades to a visible placeholder for missing slots rather than omitting headings
renderBrief never contains a lead field
renderQuote omits the per-task rate when rateShown is false
belowFloor replaces the band with a starter-engagement message
Program mode lists subsystems in dependency order labelled Phase 1..N; a cycle falls back to declaration order without throwing
Both renderers are pure
userStories.notes: Actual suite is 106/12 (baseline 96/11 per US-004a, +10 tests/1 file), not the plan's 104/12 (which assumed the pre-US-004a 92/11 baseline). Fixed a self-contradictory plan test fixture: the shared belowFloor:true Quote fixture broke 2 sibling tests expecting the band/per-task-rate path; flipped the default to false and overrode true only in the floor-specific test. Controller hardening: added negative assertions that belowFloor omits the band numbers and rate (was asserting only the message's presence), a phase-order test with subsystems declared out of dependency order, and the missing dependency-cycle test the criteria required. 106 -> 108.

userStories.title: Brief and quote persistence
userStories.description: As sales, I want every brief and quote stored as markdown in D1 so the dashboard can render them.
acceptanceCriteria: insertBrief, insertQuote, getQuoteById, getBriefByConversation exported and tested against real D1
insertQuote column/placeholder/bind counts are all 15 and stated in the report
A quote insert with an unknown brief_id throws (foreign keys are enforced)
subsystems_json round-trips as null in single mode
userStories.notes: Appended the four helpers verbatim from plan Task 6; 115 tests / 13 files, both packages typecheck. insertQuote is 15 columns / 15 placeholders / 15 binds, bind order verified pairwise against the migration's column order. FK error is verbatim 'D1_ERROR: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT (extended: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY)'.

userStories.title: POST /api/generate orchestration
userStories.description: As a visitor who finished the interview, I want a brief and an indicative quote produced and persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: 404 unknown conversation; 409 unless the session is at GENERATE
Idempotent: an existing brief for the conversation is returned without a second estimate
Rate-limited requests return the brief with quote null AND make no LLM call (assert the fetch spy)
Estimator failure still returns the brief with a graceful headline, never a 500
conversations.ended_at is written; abandoned_at_state is written when a session ends before DONE
headline never contains the per-task rate
userStories.notes: Done at 128 tests / 14 files. Idempotency is checked BEFORE the state gate, otherwise a refresh after a successful generate (session now DONE) would 409 instead of returning the brief. abandoned_at_state is written by endConversation(), unit-tested against the D1 column.

userStories.title: HMAC-signed quote retrieval
userStories.description: As a client following an emailed link, I want to read my quote without an account, while quote ids stay unguessable.
acceptanceCriteria: signId/verifyId round-trip; tampered id, tampered signature, and wrong key all fail
Verification is constant-time and length-safe
GET /api/quote/:id returns 403 on bad signature AND 403 on unknown id, so ids are not enumerable
200 returns markdown and the quote payload
userStories.notes: 151 tests / 16 files. Constant-time via crypto.subtle.verify (no === on MAC bytes); bad signature and unknown id return byte-identical 403 {error:forbidden}. QUOTE_LINK_SIGNING_KEY is now in REQUIRED_SECRETS — create it (openssl rand -hex 32) and push it before the next deploy or /api/* 503s.

userStories.title: Resend email delivery
userStories.description: As a client, I want the full cost breakdown emailed to me, with a link to the hosted quote.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML only, no attachment; fetch against api.resend.com with no SDK dependency added
A send failure logs an event and does NOT fail the request
The recipient address is read from the leads row at send time and never passes through the estimator, renderers, or any prompt
SETUP.md and scripts/sync-secrets.sh updated for RESEND_API_KEY and QUOTE_LINK_SIGNING_KEY
userStories.notes: QUOTE_LINK_SIGNING_KEY needs a new 1Password entry: openssl rand -hex 32.
